MEHREEN mid-sized Kundan TaarBaali

MOQ: 50 pcs
Enquire on WhatsApp

Elegant with a soft festive charm, these mid-size Kundan earrings feature delicate mint green stones paired with classic Kundan detailing. The circular silhouette is finished with graceful pearl bunch drops, adding subtle movement and a refined touch. Lightweight and well balanced, this pair is designed for long hours of comfortable wear. The fresh mint green tone brings a modern softness to the traditional design, making these earrings easy to style with both ethnic outfits and contemporary fusion looks. ideal for festive occasions, family functions, and intimate celebrations, these earrings are a timeless addition to any jewellery collection.
